title: CH21103: Chemical Process Calculations
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Numerical techniques for solving material & energy balance equations.
Material balance with and without chemical reactions, Recycle, bypass, purge
calculations, computer based calculations.
Vapor-liquid equilibrium: Bubble point, dew point calculations, phase envelop
calculations.
Introduction to Fuels (solid, liquid and gas): Important properties and
specifications.
Energy balances with and without chemical reactions; psychometric calculations;
fuel calculations, adiabatic flame temperature; computer-based calculations for
energy balance.
Text Book:
1.Chemical Process Principles, Part I by O. A. Hougen, K. M. Watson and R. A.
Ragatz
2.Basic Principles and Calculations in Chemical Engineering by D. M. Himmel blau.

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion

How to Crack the Paper
The course teaches the student what has been already learnt during the JEE preparation. What's new is the restricted way of solving. There exists a particular way of solving every question as directed by the professor which has to be strictly maintained. Preparation is easy, but the final result depends more on the efficiency of your calculations and how quick you solve each question. Because this course has one of the lengthiest papers of what iit kgp has to offer.
